architecture: Component Library -> Parametric Variant -> Placement / Instance -> Evidence Metadata

COLUMN.rule: Z-002 diameter; Z-006-RC-01 height; Z-005 corner rise

PRIMARY_FRAME.rule: P2.2 approved endpoints and MOD-003/004/005 section envelopes

BRACKET_ARM.rule: DG-110/111/112/113 and MOD-002; equal subdivisions are graphic topology only

BRACKET_CONTACT.rule: diagrammatic contact block from MOD-003/004/005 x MOD-002; not a DG-114 small-dou specification

PURLIN.rule: FR-007, ROOF-007/008/009, OUT-003 and module section envelopes

RAFTER.rule: FR-007 and ROOF-007/008/009 endpoint segments; diagrammatic spacing

ROOF_ENVELOPE.rule: six continuous planar strips joining approved control coordinates; no thickness claim

FRAME_SUPPORT.rule: separate P2.3 diagrammatic connector instances at approved P2.2 endpoints; not exact historical member or joint

GABLE_CONTROL.rule: diagnostic-only; roof-envelope end edge is visible

variant_policy: Stable variant ID is family plus SHA256 of canonical generator parameters; identical variants share one Blender mesh datablock. Distinct source controls or roles remain distinct variants even if dimensions match.
placement_policy: P2.2 stable object name or deterministic derived name is the stable instance ID; transforms are generated from approved P2.2 geometry/control endpoints.

graphic_only_rules.contact_block_fraction_note: fraction of diagrammatic section envelope in each axis; graphic symbol, not measured dou
graphic_only_rules.roof_surface: zero-thickness piecewise planar interpolation between P2.2 roof controls
graphic_only_rules.bracket_jump_division: two equal graphic segments per approved aggregate; no individual historical jump dimension claim
